asset: Blender trees for the pbr look: oak (willow oak), pine (loblolly), magnolia, myrtle (crape myrtle), dogwood, street (red maple). Each GLB holds tree:<species>:<0..2> (LOD0: branching trunk + leaf cards) and tree:<species>:<v>_lod1 (trunk + 3 crossed crown cards).
tool: Blender 5.2.3 LTS, headless (blender -b -P), glTF 2.0 exporter with Draco
source: scripts/blender/pbr_trees.py. Branches are seeded random tubes, leaves are quads. No library, scan, photo, or generated model is in it.
prompt: None. The script is the full recipe; run it again to rebuild the files.
credits: Original work for this project. No third-party art. No paid generation credits.
format: GLB, Draco, no materials or textures. COLOR_0 linear vertex color (bark, leaf color with baked crown occlusion), _SWAY (wind weight) and _LEAF ([u, v, seed]; the leaf cut in src/render/leaf-cut.js) custom attributes, crown-facing normals on the leaf cards.
nodes: tree_<species>_<variant> (LOD0) and tree_<species>_<variant>_lod1; GLTFLoader drops ':' so geo-view glbTreeTemplates() maps them to tree:<species>:<variant>. The game uses the GLB LOD0 only and keeps the procedural LOD1 crown cards.
